coaching.headline: Two 0-4 fights at their Fangtooth — both taken with the offlane alive and absent — plus the film flagging three of us with no armor into a four-fifths-physical comp decided this one.
coaching.team: The winning pieces were there: Drongo went 10/6 with six kills on Zinx, the support matchup was won all game, and the 14.5 teamfight was a clean 4-0 answer. But the file flags the same absence four times — the offlane alive and never joining at 13.5, 20.5, 21.9 and 26.1, all losses at or near their Fangtooth — and the film flags three of us with no armor against a comp led by Khaimera's 28k physical. The ledger closed 12 objective takes to 23, and their final run — Genesis Core at 25, Primal at 27, Orb Prime at 28 — is priced death by death in the file.
coaching.whatShiftedIt: The second 0-4 at their Fangtooth at 20.5 tipped it — Fangtooth and an inner tower fell inside a minute — and the 26.1 0-3 at their Primal pit cashed out as Primal Fangtooth, the inhibitor and Orb Prime all at once.

perPlayer.7c8ab99c-31c5-4ea5-a6fa-e0d6417c3f1b: Mr_Meat31 won the support matchup wire to wire — 17865 healing and 11 assists on Phase — but the late falls at 19.1, 20.6, 22 and 26.1 each preceded a lost Fangtooth, tower or the final collapse. On a team where three ran no armor, the link support was always the first squish down; the fix was the team's item screen as much as his positioning.
perPlayer.16f28434-561f-4f23-9454-40321f4a1ef3: Goldilocks324's Drongo won the read and the lane — 10 kills, six of them on Zinx, with first blood at 3.4 — but the 20.6, 21.9 and 26.1 deaths came in the short-handed Fangtooth fights the file prices at inner towers and the endgame. A kiting carry needs the missing bodies before entering those; the third core item (Tainted Rounds, the missing meta core) never arrived either.
perPlayer.a0c393cc-1437-4bdc-8168-64676ce2166c: Cuban Noobster's Belica drew the 'theirs all game' read into a Gadget who finished 6/1, and it showed — 3/5 with two solo catches at 5.3 and 27 and two completed items in 28 minutes. Pinned lanes are the film's excuse for missing fights; the catches on the walk are the part to drill.
perPlayer.10edbf65-457d-48d0-9151-9df5b4fcb40a: Willy Guggenheim had the team's safest line — 1/1/5 with 31,248 mitigated — and its most repeated flag: alive and never joining the losses at 13.5, 20.5, 21.9 and 26.1. Shinbi's wolfpack ult exists for exactly those grouped fights; the team fought four deciding ones without her.
perPlayer.a412baf3-dd17-4f89-8ecf-9d0704f3a79e: Xeebs' jungle read was 'theirs all game' into Wukong and the price tags landed on him: the 12.5 catch preceded their Fangtooth and the 15.4 catch preceded three towers in forty seconds. Yin hunts isolated duels, but with no armor into a four-physical comp, every one of those walks was the enemy's fight, not his.

threats: Chain-CC risk (1 hard-CC abilities, ~1.0s of lockdown): Gadget Security Gate (root 1s). Don't group tight into it — stagger the engage and hold mobility/cleanse for the key one.
Heal-stacking: Zinx. Anti-heal is mandatory against this comp — we brought 1 item of it.
Enemy is 4/5 physical — a single armor item blunts most of their damage; itemize armor on anyone diveable.
synergy: Our engage/CC: Lt. Belica Neural Disruptor (silence 0.5s). Our kills come from landing burst INSIDE that CC window — whoever lands it, the rest must follow up immediately.
We have sustain (Phase) — favor the longer fight where our heals out-grind them.
Strong AoE/teamfight kit — group at choke points and fight on top of objectives.

ourKits.combo: Telekinetic Link an ally → Psychic Flare blind → Energy Lance → Hyperflux buff ult
ourKits.winCondition: buff a hyper-carry through the Link and Hyperflux for a teamfight
ourKits.passive: abilities heal her and her linked ally
ourKits.playWith: the strongest carry to Link and supercharge
ourKits.playAgainst: kill the linked carry, not Phase; break the link timing

ourKits.combo: Old Rusty slow → Gag Grenade silence → Rad Rounds basics → Shrapnel Cannon armor shred
ourKits.winCondition: kite back, stack Wastelander bleed and Rad Rounds, melt from range
ourKits.playWith: peel and frontline so he can free-fire
ourKits.playAgainst: low mobility — dive him or break LoS through his poke; he folds to hard engage

ourKits.combo: Seismic Assault knockup → Void Bomb → Neural Disruptor silence ult, Void Drone mana drain
ourKits.winCondition: knock up + silence a target and burst with missing-HP scaling
ourKits.playAgainst: dodge Seismic Assault; she's immobile — dive when ult is down

ourKits.combo: Rushing Beat dashes → Line Tempo wolves → Circle Rhythm shield → All-Kill! wolfpack ult
ourKits.winCondition: stack Track and unleash All-Kill! in a grouped fight
ourKits.playAgainst: spread vs the wolfpack; she's squishy without her shield up

ourKits.combo: Lash Kick gap-close+slow → Windburn %hp basics → Backlash push, Quelling Gale to disengage
ourKits.passive: Rising Storm stacks grant attack speed
ourKits.playWith: a team that lets her side-lane and pick
ourKits.playAgainst: she wants 1v1s — group and burst her; Quelling Gale only stops projectiles

enemyKits.combo: Ambush leap → Unleash AS → Cull stun, Invigorate to cleanse+heal
enemyKits.winCondition: stick on one target, stun with Cull and out-sustain via Spirit Regen
enemyKits.playWith: follow-up burst inside his Cull stun
enemyKits.playAgainst: ANTI-HEAL is mandatory — it guts his whole kit; kite the leap and CC through Invigorate

enemyKits.combo: Ricochet stun → Bad Medicine zone → Infuse heal an ally → Neural Regenesis revive
enemyKits.winCondition: keep an ally alive with Infuse + the revive ult and poke with Ricochet
enemyKits.playWith: a carry she can pocket-heal and revive
enemyKits.playAgainst: she can't heal herself — dive HER; bait the revive before committing

enemyKits.combo: Piercing Shot poke → Heightened Senses AS → Hail of Arrows zone → Inner Fire ult
enemyKits.winCondition: ramp Relentless + AS and sustained-DPS the front down
enemyKits.playWith: heavy peel — she's immobile and pure DPS
enemyKits.playAgainst: she has zero escape — hard-engage her and she dies first

enemyKits.combo: Windsurge engage → Cyclebreaker damage-reduction spin → clones from 84000 Hairs
enemyKits.winCondition: stance-dance for damage or tankiness and overwhelm with clones
enemyKits.playWith: a team that fights alongside his clones
enemyKits.playAgainst: AoE clears his clones; CC him during the damage-reduction window

enemyKits.combo: Security Gate root → Sticky Mine → Tesla Dome zone ult
enemyKits.winCondition: root with the gate and trap a fight inside the Tesla Dome
enemyKits.passive: FDA stacks grant scaling magical power
enemyKits.playWith: frontline that holds enemies in her Dome
enemyKits.playAgainst: dodge the gate; spread vs the Dome — she's immobile, dive her

fedBy: Tithe of Death (minor): Takedowns restore 15% Max Mana and permanently grant 2 Ability Haste, up to 30 Ability Haste.

Field Data Accumulation (passive): Gadget acquires stacks of FDA that permanently grant 1 magical power for every 6 stacks gained. Minion & Monster Kills grant 1 stack. Damaging Enemy Heroes with abilties grants 5 stacks, once per activation. Takedowns grant 20 stacks.
ultPlus: Overseer (Exalted): Enhance your Ultimate Ability: Deals 15% more damage. Heals you for 25% of the damage dealt to Heroes.
lines: Lead story: Hard to kill. Died 1 time in 28 minutes, fewer deaths than about 89% of Gadget mid players this patch. The build added health and armor and healing off damage.
Lesson: takedowns were the fuel. Each one Gadget touched shortened Tesla Dome, so feeding early made it come back faster (about 53.7s late); fight right after Tesla Dome is spent.
Tesla Dome at rank 3: 95s base, about 53.7s by the end (43% shorter) from 77 ability haste: Soulbinder 20, Megacosm 10, Entropy 15, Soulbearer 8, Tithe of Death (minor) 24.
Tithe of Death (minor): 2 per takedown, 12 takedowns.
12 takedowns (6 kills, 6 assists) fed: Tithe of Death (minor), Field Data Accumulation (passive).
Overseer (Exalted): Enhance your Ultimate Ability: Deals 15% more damage. Heals you for 25% of the damage dealt to Heroes.
Their build heals off damage: anti-heal (the Tainted items) cuts it.
Gadget dealt 22,605 hero damage, 22% of their team's, with +435 magical power from items.

Penetration: Overseer 8, Wraith Leggings 11; against Phase (level 15: about 44 magical armor, 25 after penetration; took 5,287 magical damage from heroes, 29% of all hero damage they took) and Lt. Belica (level 15: about 44 magical armor, 25 after penetration; took 7,316 magical damage from heroes, 47% of all hero damage they took) that is about 15% and 15% more damage (estimate: percent penetration taken before flat).
Soulbinder (item): Damage Heroes from afar with Abilities: Deal 8% bonus Damage. Activates at 1450+ Range.
Megacosm (item): On dealing Ability Damage: Deal 2.5% of Target's Max Health as Damage over 3s. Additional applications refresh the duration.
Megacosm (item): On dealing Ability Damage to Heroes: Deal 6% of Target's Bonus Health as Damage over 3s.
Entropy (item): On dealing Ability Damage: Deal 3 (+3.5%) additional Damage. Each Ability can only trigger this effect once every 0.2s, per Target.
Overseer (item): Ultimate: Deals 15% more damage. Heals you for 25% of the damage dealt to Heroes.
Wraith Leggings (item): Against Heroes below 40% Health: Abilities deal 12% bonus Magical Damage.
Vesh (Eternal): Ability damage dealt to Enemy Heroes deals 7% (+0.4% a minute, about 18.2% by the end) of that damage as a DoT over 3s.
Mind Rot (Eternal minor): The major also deals 2% of the target's current health as bonus damage.

Sustain: 7% magical lifesteal; Overseer: Ultimate: Deals 15% more damage. Heals you for 25% of the damage dealt to Heroes.; Soulbearer: Gain a 100 (+35) (+6%) Shield for 8s. Gain 20% Magical Lifesteal and 10% Movement Speed for 8s.; 1,695 healing recorded.
Toughness: +250 health; took 11,708 damage, mitigated 7,253, died 1 times.
Lesson: Gadget's penetration cut through: Phase took about 15% more magical damage than their armor alone allows (estimate: at level 15 their armor was about 44, about 25 after 19 flat penetration).

(game text: Sticky Mine's explosion radius is increased by 35%. Enhancing a Mine on an Enemy Hero grants 3 additional FDA stacks.) (changes Sticky Mine, 4.5s cooldown with their haste) Field: 48.5% in 1661 games, 29% of picks, below the hero-role's 50%.

(game text: Ability damage dealt to Enemy Heroes deals 7% (+0.4% per minute) of that damage as a DoT over 3s.) [7% growing 0.4% a minute: about 18.2% by the end (28 min)] Field: 48.6% in 3504 games, 60% of picks, below the hero-role's 50%.

Loadout minor Tithe of Death: Takedowns refill mana and permanently shorten ability cooldowns, up to a cap. Gadget casts abilities more often the better fights go. (game text: Takedowns restore 15% Max Mana and permanently grant 2 Ability Haste, up to 30 Ability Haste.) Field: 49.8% in 1798 games, 51% of picks, level the hero-role's 50%.

Loadout minor Mind Rot: Vesh's burn also deals damage based on the target's current health, so it hits hardest against full-health tanks. (game text: The major also deals 2% of the target's current health as bonus damage.) Field: 48.2% in 2514 games, 72% of picks, below the hero-role's 50%.

Loadout crest Soulbearer: Activate for a shield, healing off magic damage and a bit of speed. Use it as Tesla Dome starts so its long damage window heals Gadget. (game text: Anima:  Gain a 100 (+35) (+6%) Shield for 8s. Gain 20% Magical Lifesteal and 10% Movement Speed for 8s.) Field: 52.7% in 867 games, 15% of picks, above the hero-role's 50%.

Stack (Every ability hit set off): 5 effects on one trigger: Megacosm, Entropy, Wraith Leggings, Vesh, Mind Rot. Gadget has 4 damaging abilities (Seek and Destroy, Sticky Mine, Tesla Dome hit an area, so one cast sets them off on several heroes), and 77 ability haste brought them back 44% sooner: more casts, more triggers.
Stack (Damage that scales with the target's health): 2 effects on one trigger: Megacosm, Mind Rot. The more health a target stacks, the more these deal, so health items on the other side fed them.
Stack (Healing off the damage): 2 effects on one trigger: Overseer, Soulbearer.

The Eternal was part of it: Vesh (Tithe of Death + Mind Rot) sits on the same triggers as the items (every ability hit set off; damage that scales with the target's health), so the same hits paid out twice.
Countered? 0 of the 4 players Gadget killed built magical armor. Anti-heal on Shinbi. We killed Gadget 1 time.

Copy it? Vesh (Tithe of Death + Mind Rot): 49.3% in 1,563 Gadget midlane games, level with the hero's 50%; this 3-item core: 50% in 58 games, below the 53.6% of that hero-role's cores. It wins less than usual elsewhere: it beat us, not the field.

card.lesson: Gadget's takedowns fed Tesla Dome: every kill or assist made it come back sooner. Deny early takedowns and fight right after Tesla Dome is used.
